name: context-decision
description: Decision continuity with actual-body comparison, proactive conflict notices, and approval-gated capture.

interface.shortDescription: Compare, preserve, and safely change decisions.
interface.longDescription: Before a choice is finalized, supplies related Current decision bodies for same, supporting, rationale-changed, conflict, or new assessment; preserves approved decisions with rationale and rejected alternatives and marks superseded history do_not_follow.
defaultPrompt: Before any repository operation, require the exact installed and enabled context-core@jeis-ai-plugins source, context-common/v2 protocol, and a compatible doctor receipt.

For an explicitly invoked $context-decision:init, accept doctor repository_state=ready, partial, invalid, or absent; delegate target-scoped core repair and decision registration plus the active host name to context-core so the same call reaches decision ready and installs the managed policy.

When discussion converges on or changes a choice, use $context-decision:decision to compare actual Current bodies before concluding; report rationale changes or conflicts and only capture an explicit accepted choice with scope and commitment.

Never install, enable, or update plugins, probe plugin caches, or embed context-core; fixed init policy installation is allowed, while all non-init durable mutations remain exact-digest approval gated through the context-core coordinator.
